subject: Tel Aviv trip: holding the week
body: I have held Monday 19 October through Thursday 22 October for the Cedar Mobility, BlueHarbor, and investor conversations. Please keep customer calls movable.

subject: Q3 close: board pack inputs
body: Could you send the updated pipeline split and October hiring assumptions by Friday? I am locking the board pack after the close.

subject: LoomRoute: exception queue review
body: The new exception queue keeps the reason trace visible while an operator edits the plan. I would like product eyes on the override wording.

subject: Customer reference: Vela Foods
body: Vela is comfortable describing the late-delivery reduction work, provided we call them a design customer rather than naming the carrier.

subject: Security review checklist
body: For the next pilot pack, please cover SSO, audit events, retention controls, and the explicit statement that no production credentials enter the demo.

subject: Re: travel dates
body: Those dates work. I can take the product narrative and the operator workflow; Priya and I will make the synthetic shipment story feel real.

subject: Cedar Mobility context
body: Cedar wants explainability and manual override, not another opaque score. Please frame the pilot around fewer late-delivery decisions and a measurable baseline.

subject: Recruiting: solutions engineer shortlist
body: The shortlist now has three candidates with warehouse integrations experience. I have put first interviews on your calendar for next week.

subject: BlueHarbor integration questions
body: I have a first pass on API rate limits, webhook retries, and EU-Israel data residency. Their sandbox shape will determine how much we can prove in October.

subject: Cedar Mobility introduction
body: We would like to understand how LoomRoute explains a recommendation to a dispatch manager. A short working session in Tel Aviv would be useful.

subject: Re: Cedar Mobility introduction
body: That is exactly the conversation we want. We will bring a synthetic shipment set and leave room for your operators to challenge each decision.

subject: Dune Ventures information request
body: Dune asked for runway, pipeline concentration, and the conversion assumptions behind the next two quarters. Keep customer names redacted in the first pass.

subject: Re: Tel Aviv introduction
body: Happy to share the redacted operating metrics before we meet. Elena will cover the Series A story and I will walk through partner conversion.

subject: Flight meal preference
body: Could you mark my outbound and return flights for the VGML meal? It is easy to miss on short routes, so please confirm it appears on both reservations.

subject: Re: Flight meal preference
body: Done for both sectors and noted against your passenger record. The confirmation is in the travel folder.

subject: Vela Foods renewal notes
body: Their renewal is on track, but the warehouse team wants a CSV export of reason codes. John, can you find fifteen minutes with them next week?

subject: Roadmap trade-off
body: I recommend delaying the carrier score redesign until after the explainability instrumentation ships. The latter is the story Cedar will actually test.

subject: Tel Aviv hotel hold
body: The Norman Tel Aviv is holding four rooms at 23-25 Nachmani Street from 19 to 22 October. Please send passport-name spellings by Wednesday.

subject: Synthetic data boundary
body: The demo bundle can include fabricated consignments and generated carrier names. Please do not paste a customer export into the workshop laptop.

subject: BlueHarbor sandbox agenda
body: We can show the port-event feed and discuss retries. Our main concerns are rate limits, webhook replay, and where tenant data is processed.

subject: Re: BlueHarbor sandbox agenda
body: Great. I will bring a sequence diagram with a bounded retry policy and a clear answer on tenant-region routing.

subject: Draft Tel Aviv run sheet
body: I am building the run sheet around Cedar, Dune, BlueHarbor, and the Vector Labs reception. Please flag immovable customer commitments today.

subject: Workshop lunch constraints
body: For the workshop soup, can we remove chicken stock? Dairy and eggs are fine for me, but no fish or meat. I would rather avoid a last-minute scramble.

subject: Re: Workshop lunch constraints
body: Noted. I asked the caterer for a vegetable stock and separate dairy garnish. John requested the chicken option, so they will label both clearly.

subject: Dune questions before October
body: Could you cover defensibility beyond the model, customer concentration, and what converts a design partner into a paid rollout? Noa will join from our growth team.

subject: Series A narrative draft
body: The through-line is explainable operational decisions, not generic AI. I will connect the Cedar outcome to a repeatable path across fleet and warehouse teams.

subject: Budget outlook
body: August spend is within plan. If the pilot converts on schedule, the onboarding work fits the current hiring model without pulling forward the fundraise.

subject: Passport names received
body: All four passport spellings are now with the travel desk. I will distribute ticket numbers when the agency finishes ticketing.

subject: Vector Labs reception
body: We would be delighted to have the Northstar Loom team at our 21 October reception at the Tel Aviv Museum of Art. Michal Tal, events lead.

subject: Tuesday dinner idea
body: I keep thinking about smoked aubergine and fermented chili as the ideal dinner after a day of demos. Something bold but not heavy would be perfect.

subject: Re: Dinner idea
body: I will ask for options near Rothschild and the hotel. Elena is keen on one team dinner and one partner dinner, so we can make both nights distinct.

subject: SOSA room confirmation
body: SOSA can host the BlueHarbor integration session and the afternoon architecture workshop on 20 October. We will have a screen and whiteboard ready.

subject: Architecture workshop ownership
body: You own the event contract and regional routing. I will join remotely for the retry discussion, then review the written decisions next morning.

subject: Flight confirmations
body: Ticketing is complete for London to Tel Aviv on 18 October and the return on 22 October. The working meetings remain 19-22 October.

subject: Partner follow-up template
body: I made a short follow-up template for the pilot decision, technical risks, and named next step. It should keep the October notes actionable.

subject: DPA review points
body: Please make the DPA owner and retention period explicit in the Cedar closeout. Security can turn comments around within two business days.

subject: Pipeline concentration snapshot
body: The top three accounts represent 41 percent of qualified pipeline, down from 48 percent last month. The story improves if we show the active mid-market funnel.

subject: Cedar session shape
body: We suggest a 90-minute discovery using three synthetic dispatch cases, followed by a definition of success. We will leave manual overrides visible throughout.

subject: Re: Cedar session shape
body: The outline works. We would also like a view of the baseline late-delivery decisions so the pilot can be judged against something operational.

subject: Tuesday dinner brief
body: The plant-centered tasting option sounds right. I like a menu that puts vegetables first, and it should make a memorable close to the customer day.

subject: Provisional dinner holds
body: I have a provisional hold at Claro on 19 October and Opa on 20 October. I will release the second option if the partner schedule changes.

subject: Webhook replay example
body: Attached is a redacted event sequence. Could you confirm whether replay tokens expire independently of the original webhook window?

subject: Re: Webhook replay example
body: They do expire independently. I will bring the exact interval and our sandbox quota to the technical session.

subject: Dune metrics preview
body: Attached is the redacted view of pipeline, runway, and pilot conversion. We can unpack the moat question around workflow data and operator trust.

subject: Re: Dune metrics preview
body: Thanks. The operating lens is useful. We would like to understand how much of the product remains defensible when customers change carriers.

subject: Ground transport
body: Please keep airport transfers flexible. We may need a quiet buffer before the Cedar session rather than a tightly scheduled city tour.

subject: Re: Ground transport
body: Understood. I put flexible transfer requests against the hotel and left the afternoons open where the run sheet allows.

subject: Demo build freeze
body: I will freeze the synthetic demo build on 9 October. Please log copy changes in the product board before then so QA can test the same story.

subject: Re: Demo build freeze
body: I will keep the operator language stable. One request: make the reason trace readable without opening a second panel.

subject: Restaurant preference check
body: The two dinner holds are confirmed as vegetarian-friendly. Let me know if you need any other dietary notes passed to the kitchens.

subject: Customer success dashboard
body: The new dashboard separates adoption from alert volume. I am testing whether the account team can spot a stalled rollout without asking analytics.

subject: Insurance renewal
body: The cyber policy renewal needs the latest security questionnaire. Arun has the technical answers; I only need the signed officer declaration.

subject: Re: Insurance renewal
body: I sent the questionnaire answers and confirmed that customer payloads are encrypted in transit and at rest. The officer declaration can follow.

subject: October run sheet v2
body: The current plan has Cedar on Monday, BlueHarbor on Tuesday, the investor lunch on Wednesday, and the final review Thursday morning.

subject: Partner meeting roles
body: You open the Dune conversation and close with the pilot-to-revenue path. I will handle company direction; keep the discussion concrete and short.

subject: Presentation equipment
body: Can you confirm the rooms have HDMI and reliable guest Wi-Fi? I will carry the backup deck locally in case the venue network is unhelpful.

subject: Re: Presentation equipment
body: Both SOSA rooms have HDMI, guest Wi-Fi, and a whiteboard. I will be there at 08:30 on Tuesday to let the group in.

subject: Operator research synthesis
body: The strongest pattern is that dispatchers trust a visible reason and a reversible action. I have folded both into the demo script.

subject: Phone case for demo day
body: I found a bright sunflower-yellow case for my black Pixel. Is it too loud for the Cedar demo? I can swap it if we want a more subdued table.

subject: Re: Phone case for demo day
body: Keep it. It will be easy to spot among chargers, and it is more cheerful than another black accessory.

subject: Residency wording
body: For BlueHarbor, I will say tenant records remain in the selected region and that the sandbox contains no production identifiers. Please sanity-check the wording.

subject: Re: Residency wording
body: That wording is accurate. Add that audit events are retained separately from operational payloads, with the period agreed in the DPA.

subject: Calendar blocks published
body: The detailed calendar blocks are published with travel buffers. Please treat the Tuesday SOSA workshop as a single customer day even though it has two sessions.

subject: Cedar success metrics
body: Propose three measures: decision latency, late-delivery decisions avoided, and override acceptance. We can refine the thresholds with Dana and Amir.

subject: Re: Cedar success metrics
body: Those measures match our operators' concerns. We would like the first week to establish the baseline before any target is declared.

subject: Re: Dinner holds
body: Claro confirmed 19:45 on Monday for four. Opa confirmed 19:30 on Tuesday for the partner group; both have the notes you gave me.

subject: Re: Dinner holds
body: Perfect. For Claro, add Yael and Eitan to the headcount. I will confirm the remaining partner names after BlueHarbor replies.

subject: Data room index
body: The investor data room index is clean: cap table, runway, pipeline, security overview, and customer references are separated into review folders.

subject: Reference permission update
body: Vela approved a reference call but not a public logo. Use the anonymous case note in the investor pack and keep their name out of slides.

subject: Demo snack question
body: Could the meeting snacks include fruit and something savory without meat? I am happy with cheese or eggs, just trying to keep the table simple for everyone.

subject: Re: Demo snack question
body: Added fruit, labneh, and roasted vegetables to the request. John asked for sesame pastries as well, so the spread will have variety.

subject: Sandbox credentials process
body: We issue short-lived sandbox tokens at the start of the session. No credentials need to be emailed, and the quota resets overnight.

subject: Re: Sandbox credentials process
body: Excellent. I will bring a local fixture for the opening walkthrough and use the live sandbox only for the retry and rate-limit checks.

subject: Release candidate ready
body: The redacted demo release candidate is ready for review. It includes manual override, reason trace, and the three Cedar cases.

subject: Re: Release candidate ready
body: I ran through it on a clean laptop. The story lands well; I only changed two labels so the operator sees why an action is reversible.

subject: Travel pack v3
body: The travel pack now includes hotel, venue addresses, meeting owners, and local contact numbers. I will print one copy for each traveler.

subject: Re: Travel pack v3
body: Thank you. Add the final-review room detail once the Norman confirms it, and keep the departure block visible on the first page.

subject: Travel desk reminders
body: Online check-in opens tomorrow. The hotel has the four names, and the venue hosts have the current arrival list.

subject: Looking forward to 19 October
body: We are looking forward to meeting at Mindspace Rothschild. We will arrive with a concise product story and spend most of the time on your operational questions.

subject: Reception access details
body: Your names are on the guest list for the 21 October reception at 27 Shaul HaMelech. Doors open at 18:30; please bring photo ID.

subject: Re: Phone case for demo day
body: Did you decide about the star sticker? A small white Northstar mark should still be visible against the yellow case if you use it.

subject: Re: Phone case for demo day
body: Yes, I added the small white Northstar star sticker. It is distinctive enough to find quickly without covering the camera.

subject: October payroll cut-off
body: October payroll closes on the 9th. If the trip produces any reimbursable changes, please send receipts to Hannah before month end.

subject: Final security sign-off
body: The demo scope is approved: synthetic data only, local backup, SSO explanation, audit-log view, and no production credentials. Good to go.

subject: Norman final review room
body: The Norman confirms the final review for Thursday 22 October at 09:30 in the conservatory. The library bar remains held for Wednesday's internal debrief.

subject: Demo narrative final
body: The narrative now starts with a late-delivery decision, shows the evidence, then lets the operator override it. It should invite Cedar to disagree productively.

subject: Packing and contact sheet
body: I have printed the contact sheet and partner one-pagers. I will carry the paper copies and keep the meeting notes in the shared offline folder.

subject: Final itinerary distributed
body: The final itinerary is distributed: meetings, dinners, hotel, reception, internal debrief, and Thursday departures are all in local Tel Aviv time.

subject: Cedar attendee list
body: Dana and Amir will attend the discovery on Monday. We will bring an operations manager to test the manual override cases.

subject: BlueHarbor attendee list
body: Eitan and I will join both Tuesday sessions. We can decide on the sandbox scope after the architecture workshop rather than guessing beforehand.

subject: Last call before departure
body: Please download the offline pack and check your travel documents. Monday's first customer session is at 13:30, with no planned meeting before then.

subject: Arrived in Tel Aviv
body: We have arrived and are set for 13:30 at Mindspace Rothschild. Looking forward to testing the cases together.

subject: Cedar notes before dinner
body: Cedar responded well to the visible reason trace and asked us to quantify late-delivery decisions avoided. I captured the wording for Thursday's review.

subject: BlueHarbor technical checkpoint
body: The sandbox quota is workable, and we have a retry design to test this afternoon. Residency remains a DPA item rather than a blocker for the fixture.

subject: Technical sandbox next step
body: The architecture workshop was productive. We agree in principle to a bounded technical sandbox; I will send the endpoint list after our dinner.

subject: Cedar pilot shape
body: Thank you for the candid negotiation this morning. We have a shared outline for a 90-day pilot, pending the DPA and agreed success metrics.

subject: Follow-up data room session
body: The conversation was useful. Please schedule a follow-up data room session so we can go deeper on conversion evidence and workflow defensibility.

subject: Reception and debrief wrap
body: Vector was a helpful technical bridge, and the internal debrief captured owners for Cedar, BlueHarbor, and Dune. I will turn notes into follow-ups tomorrow.

subject: Tel Aviv outcomes
body: Cedar agrees in principle to the 90-day pilot pending DPA and metrics, BlueHarbor will enter a technical sandbox, and Dune wants the data room follow-up.

subject: Departures and receipts
body: The final review is complete and departures are scheduled from noon. Please upload receipts and action owners when you are back online.
